Append to p12-q12: e. The tangent meets the y-axis at R. Find R. Answer: (0,1/2−π/4). f. The normal meets the x-axis at S. Find S. Answer: (π/4+1/2,0). g. Find the area of triangle ORS. Answer: (π²−4)/32 units². h. Compare the areas of triangles ORS and OPQ. Answer: They are equal.

[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-4795fae66e]
Append to p17-q13: d. The line y=nx is tangent to y=e^{4x} at Q. Find Q. Answer: Q=(1/4,e). e. Find n. Answer: n=4e. f. Compare the coordinates of P and Q. Answer: Q has half the x-coordinate of P and the same y-coordinate. g. Compare m and n. Answer: n=2m.
